purpose: Materialize traversal-conditioned continuous collision/support evidence and qualify every sealed S01/S06/S10 C08 frame before causal replay.

approval.scope: One non-overwrite C08 V6 continuous-layered materialization/qualification for exactly S01/S06/S10, 312 edges, 624 directed traversals and 4773 frames; zero LiDAR/model/checkpoint/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: After the 25/25 hard-switch seam failure, the recommended parameter-free continuous radial selected-layer to incident-union transition was presented and the user replied '继续'.

raw_sources: Three sealed C08 graph.json, splines.json and geometry_parameters.json inputs bound by SHA-256 in the run spec.
Three sealed C08 trajectory NPZ and traversal JSON inputs bound by SHA-256 in the run spec.
The sealed V3R visualization failure patch is used only by the unchanged sanitation regression test.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only Cano-derived development evidence. Native OBJ, C09/C10, M-TARE, model outputs and checkpoints are excluded.

sampling.rule: Preserve exact world, edge/traversal, route order, route arc and frame index. Geometry and transition rules freeze before trajectory reads. Audit identical frames at 0.10/0.05/0.025m; resolution evaluations are not new samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Sealed traversal identity selects one physical-tunnel field; inside a compatible fixed-radius window, cubic smoothstep transitions continuously from selected layer at the sphere to incident union at the node center.
teacher.valid_mask: At all resolutions every frame must have horizontal clearance >=0.8m, downward distance in [0.95,1.05]m and upward clearance >=0.8m; continuity and pass/fail identity must hold.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model or planner consumes outputs. PASS only removes the C08 geometry eligibility blocker and does not execute or pass Gate 4.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C08 development geometries and trajectories are readable; C09/C10 are listed solely to enforce exclusion.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only under 4 GiB address-space cap; 150 serial per-layer visualization patches, 14319 frame-resolution audits, 10309680 horizontal and 42957 vertical field rays; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 25 windows, 50 window-layer records, 624 arc endpoints, 150 patch records, three corrected trajectories, 4773-row audit, resolution/continuity/environment/input/tool hashes.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Three complete per-world XY/XZ/safety figures and every serialized per-layer visualization patch.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, window conflict, transition/seam/isolation failure, remaining degenerate/nonmanifold patch, resolution disagreement, resource breach, failed frame or continuity regression seals FAIL; no tuning, deletion or retry.
